capture_method: Actual Cua browser-tab screenshots sampled approximately every 500 ms within capture blocks; silent. No UI reconstruction or synthetic app frames. H.264 repeats held frames at 10 fps; original motion sampling is ~2 fps.
editing: Outside the uninterrupted exercise, gaps over 3 seconds are shortened to 3 seconds. Within the exercise all timestamp gaps are retained, holding the last captured frame. Last frame held 2.5 seconds. Enable English subtitles; full transcript accompanies video.

chapters.text: October 31: mello quiet coast. Original generated scenery, solid task surfaces, and no assistant in the top navigation. Fictional coursework demonstration; no clinical claims.
Three direct choices: unchanged 4/6 breathing, 5-4-3-2-1 grounding, and STOP. Each has one-minute intended pacing, no required writing, and explicit pause/exit.
Approved grounding steps are fixed in application data. The model cannot alter instructions or pacing. Pause allows more time; sensory recall is an explicit access option.
This demonstration intentionally ends early: Stopped is a partial record, never Completed. Separate actual complete Grounding and STOP timings are linked in the evaluation.
The only assistant lives in this lower-right popup. Prepared replies use reviewed copy; optional voice retains a text alternative. New-skill questions have their own approved topic.
History names the actual skill and distinguishes Completed, Stopped, Interrupted and never-started conversations. Dates and truthful save states remain.
